quiz_item.question: How do woven fabrics and knitted fabrics differ in the way yarns are assembled, and how does that structure affect the fabric's behavior?
options: A. Woven fabrics are fused directly from loose fibers using heat and glue, whereas knitted fabrics are spun without yarn.
B. Woven fabrics interlace two perpendicular sets of yarn (warp and weft) on a loom to create a firm, stable cloth.
C. Woven fabrics can only be made from synthetic polyester, whereas knitted fabrics can only be made from natural sheep wool.
D. Knitted fabrics have zero elasticity and unravel only when cut with pinking shears.
choices: A. Woven fabrics are fused directly from loose fibers using heat and glue, whereas knitted fabrics are spun without yarn.
B. Woven fabrics interlace two perpendicular sets of yarn (warp and weft) on a loom to create a firm, stable cloth.
C. Woven fabrics can only be made from synthetic polyester, whereas knitted fabrics can only be made from natural sheep wool.
D. Knitted fabrics have zero elasticity and unravel only when cut with pinking shears.
quiz_item.correct_answer: B. Woven fabrics interlace two perpendicular sets of yarn (warp and weft) on a loom to create a firm, stable cloth.
quiz_item.explanation: Correct Answer (B): Weaving crosses lengthwise warp yarns and crosswise weft yarns at right angles for dimensional stability, while knitting forms interlocking loops that give garments natural stretch and recovery.

misconception_pool.fact: Industrial technical textiles reinforce automobile tires, filter municipal water, and form heat shields on spacecraft.

misconception_pool.fact: Manufactured fibers extruded from petrochemicals, wood pulp, and molten glass make up a large share of modern everyday textiles.

misconception_pool.misconception: Knitted fabrics are constructed by crisscrossing two perpendicular sets of straight yarns over and under each other.
misconception_pool.fact: Woven fabrics interlace perpendicular warp and weft yarns, whereas knitted fabrics form interlocking loops that stretch easily.

misconception_pool.misconception: Acrylic and polyester yarns will felt and shrink into a solid mat just like 100% animal wool in hot soapy water.
misconception_pool.fact: Only animal hair fibers like wool have microscopic overlapping scales that ratchet together during wet felting agitation.

misconception_pool.misconception: Natural plant dyes from berries or onion skins bond permanently to cotton fibers without needing a mordant.
misconception_pool.fact: Most natural dyes wash out of cellulose fibers rapidly unless the fabric is pre-treated with a mineral mordant like alum or iron.

misconception_pool.misconception: Waterproofed canvas and water-repellent fabrics block liquid water using the exact same pore-sealing coating.
misconception_pool.fact: Water-repellent finishes cause droplets to bead while leaving pores breathable, whereas waterproof coatings seal pores completely.

B. Woven fabrics interlace two perpendicular sets of yarn (warp and weft) on a loom to create a firm, stable cloth.
C. Woven fabrics can only be made from synthetic polyester, whereas knitted fabrics can only be made from natural sheep wool.

choices: A. Woven fabrics are fused directly from loose fibers using heat and glue, whereas knitted fabrics are spun without yarn.

patrol_quiz_bank.correct_answer: B. Woven fabrics interlace two perpendicular sets of yarn (warp and weft) on a loom to create a firm, stable cloth, whereas knitted fabrics interlock loops of yarn to create a flexible, stretchy material.
